cases.given: Central curation, open pull requests, and federated registries have materially different trust and maintenance tradeoffs.
cases.expect: One executable governance plan with two retired alternatives and explicit reasons.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: a locked source dictates a single faithful transformation
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: A hard truth, safety, or authorization veto cannot be outvoted by soft quality scores.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible
the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
A task has several credible approaches.
cases.expect: The skill creates 2–3 materially distinct branches under shared constraints, evaluates uniformly, commits to one outcome, and retires losers.
cases.reject: The skill merely brainstorms options, uses cosmetic variants, or leaves multiple active plans after selection.
